entities.name: Type III pantothenate kinase
observations: The 235-aa query exactly matches reviewed UniProt entry Q11Q02 (Cytophaga hutchinsonii); annotated as type III pantothenate kinase, EC 2.7.1.33.
Catalyzes the first phosphorylation step in coenzyme A biosynthesis: (R)-pantothenate + ATP → (R)-4'-phosphopantothenate + ADP + H+.
